title: Meet the Meta World
objectives: Know the 3 major apps in Meta's advertising ecosystem
Understand the role of Facebook Page, Business Portfolio, and Ad Account
Complete the Indian ad account checklist including GST details

blocks.text: Meta connects Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp under one single advertising engine!
Over 500 million people across India use these apps daily to connect, explore products, and chat with local businesses.

blocks.title: The Shopping Mall Analogy
blocks.text: Meta Business Portfolio is like owning a floor in a mall. Your Facebook Page and Instagram profile are your shopfronts. Your Ad Account is your billing register.

blocks.title: The 4 Core Assets You Need
items: 3. Meta Business Portfolio (the central control room)
4. Meta Ad Account (where budgets and campaigns live)

blocks.text: Never run ads from a personal Facebook profile. Always use a dedicated Business Portfolio for security.
In India, enter your 18% GST number in Ad Account settings. This lets you claim back input tax credit on your ad spends!

quiz.q: Which tool acts as the central command room for managing Meta ad accounts, pages, and pixels?
quiz.hint: Think of the tool that holds all team permissions and business assets.
quiz.explain: Meta Business Portfolio connects all assets, team members, and payment methods in one secure place.

quiz.q: Why should Indian business owners add their GST number to their Meta Ad Account?
options: To claim 18% Input Tax Credit on ad invoices
It is required to change ad fonts
quiz.hint: Think about business taxes and claiming back expenses.
quiz.explain: Adding your GST number ensures Meta generates official GST invoices so you can claim back 18% tax credit.

quiz.q: True or False: An ad created in Meta Ads Manager can run on both Instagram and Facebook simultaneously.
quiz.hint: Meta operates both platforms from the same ads engine.
quiz.explain: True! One Meta campaign can automatically deliver across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and Audience Network.

quiz.q: Order the hierarchy of Meta business setup from broadest container to individual ad.
quiz.hint: Start with the company-wide account, then billing, campaign, and finally creative.
quiz.explain: The Business Portfolio holds the Ad Account, which runs the Campaign, which displays the Ad Creative.

recap: Meta ads run across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp from one dashboard.
Business Portfolio holds your assets, and adding GST saves 18% in tax credits.
